;Business and economy
*[[Amazon HQ2]]
**[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] announces it will split their second headquarters in [[New York City]] and [[National Landing]] in [[Northern Virginia|northern Virginia]] (outside [[Washington D.C.]]) [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/11/13/tech/amazon-hq2-nyc-arlington/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**The death toll of the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] in [[Butte County, California|Butte County]], the deadliest wildfire in [[History of California|Californian history]], rises to 48 people while dozens are missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46201718 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[CNN v. Trump]]
**[[CNN]] files a lawsuit against the Trump administration, claiming its revocation of [[White House]] correspondent [[Jim Acosta]]'s press pass on November 7 violated their [[First Amendment to the United States Constitution|First]] and [[Fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution|Fifth]] Amendment rights. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/style/cnn-sues-white-house-to-regain-access-for-reporter-jim-acosta/2018/11/13/afc3423c-e6bf-11e8-bbdb-72fdbf9d4fed_story.html?utm_term=.de883dbd108e (''The Washington Post'')]
**Several media organizations file [[Amicus curiae|amicus briefs]] in support of CNN. [https://thehill.com/homenews/media/416630-fox-news-backs-cnns-lawsuit-against-trump-administration (Vox)]
**[[One America News Network]] files an amicus brief in support of the Trump administration. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/11/16/oann-backs-trump-in-lawsuit-for-revoking-cnn-reporters-press-pass.html (CNBC)]
*[[Pike County, Ohio shootings]]
**Four suspects have been arrested for the murders of eight members of a family in 2016. Police believe custody of a child plays a role in this case. One of the suspects has a child with one of the victims. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/13/us/ohio-piketon-killings-arrests/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Bishop International Airport incident]]
**Amor Ftouhi is found guilty of three federal charges in the stabbing of an airport police officer last year in [[Flint, Michigan]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/montreal-man-convicted-terrorism-michigan-airport-stabbing-n935841 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Sri Lankan constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Sri Lanka]] reverses [[President of Sri Lanka|President]] [[Maithripala Sirisena]]'s decisions to dissolve [[Parliament of Sri Lanka|Parliament]] and to hold snap elections. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/sri-lanka-supreme-court-overturns-dissolution-parliament-181113125340789.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom]] says that UK and [[European Union|EU]] negotiators reached a draft agreement and that it will be discussed by [[Cabinet of the United Kingdom|Cabinet]] tomorrow. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/uk-cabinet-meet-britain-eu-reach-draft-brexit-59165929 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[2026 Winter Olympics]]
**Residents of the city of [[Calgary]] head to the polls to vote on a non-binding [[Referendum|plebiscite]] to determine if the city should make a bid to host the 2026 Winter Olympic Games. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/sports/non-binding-vote-today-on-hosting-olympics-in-calgary-1.4174709 (CTV News)]
**The unofficial results suggest the No vote is in the lead, and only a 40% voter turnout. Official results will be released Friday, November 16. [http://vote2018.calgary.ca/Vote-2018-results.html (City of Calgary)]
*[[First Lady of the United States]] [[Melania Trump]] calls for the ousting of [[Deputy National Security Advisor (United States)|Deputy National Security Advisor]] [[Mira Ricardel]]. [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2018/11/13/melania-trump-says-bolton-deputy-should-be-ousted.html (''Toronto Star'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-ricardel/trump-considers-ousting-national-security-deputy-over-feud-with-first-lady-sources-idUSKCN1NI2IL (Reuters)]
*The [[Islamic City Council of Tehran]] appoints [[Pirouz Hanachi]] as the new [[List of mayors of Tehran|mayor]] of [[Tehran]], the third in 18 months. [https://www.rferl.org/a/tehran-city-council-elects-third-mayor-in-18-months/29598574.html (RFE/RL)]

;Science and technology
*[[Timeline of nuclear fusion]]
**[[China]]'s [[Hefei Institutes of Physical Science]] announces that its [[Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak]] (EAST) reactor in [[Hefei]] has reached a milestone of 100 million degrees celsius. [https://news.cgtn.com/news/3d3d414f3455544e30457a6333566d54/share_p.html (CGTN)]
